articles.headline: Shah Rukh Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan Reunite for King Song Daddy Cool
articles.dek: Shah Rukh Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan have teamed up for Daddy Cool, the second song from the upcoming action-thriller King, directed by Siddharth Anand.

p: Shah Rukh Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan have officially come back together for the release of Daddy Cool, which serves as the second musical offering from the upcoming action-thriller King. The track offers audiences another exciting preview of what to expect from the Siddharth Anand directorial ahead of its theatrical debut.

The newly unveiled song follows the earlier release of Tu Mil Jaaye. While the first track paired Shah Rukh with Deepika Padukone, the latest song highlights a nostalgic yet stylish dynamic between Shah Rukh and Kareena.

body.h: Social Media Reveals and Birthday Teasers
p: To share the track with his fans, Shah Rukh posted the song on Instagram alongside a playful caption declaring his reunion with Bebo and describing the tune as old school yet cool. This followed earlier hype generated by Kareena when she confirmed her appearance in the project on November 2 while celebrating Shah Rukh's birthday.

On that occasion, Kareena also posted a striking monochrome teaser image capturing silhouettes of herself and Shah Rukh facing each other in a poised dance posture. The atmospheric backlighting highlighted their side profiles against an arched light structure while keeping their expressions hidden.

The musical rollout began at midnight on November 2 as part of Shah Rukh's birthday celebrations, when the production team launched the movie's inaugural track, Tu Mil Jaaye. Accompanying that release, Shah Rukh shared online reflections about an era of love blossoming amid gunpowder and battles.

This initial song launch arrived shortly after the studio unveiled an action-packed poster for the feature. The continuous stream of promotional content has steadily built momentum for the project throughout the late months of 2026.
The upcoming cinematic venture features an expansive cast alongside the primary leads. The ensemble includes Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Jackie Shroff, Arshad Warsi, and Raghav Juyal.

In addition to Kareena and Deepika making special appearances, Rani Mukerji is also slated for a special appearance in the film. The production is a collaborative effort co-produced by Gauri Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment alongside Siddharth and Mamta Anand's Marflix Pictures.

King marks a prominent return to the big screen for Shah Rukh following his previous cinematic appearance in Dunki. The action-thriller is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026.

With Siddharth Anand at the helm, the movie combines large-scale action sequences with high-profile musical collaborations, positioning it as one of the most anticipated theatrical events of the late 2026 calendar.

Shah Rukh Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan have reunited for the release of the second song titled Daddy Cool from the upcoming action-thriller King. Directed by Siddharth Anand and co-produced by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures, the film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on December 24, 2026.

articles.headline: HBO Max Releases Teaser for Grim German Mystery Series Sonnental From Dark Creators
articles.dek: The creators of Dark are back with Sonnental, a chilling German murder mystery limited series slated to arrive on HBO Max in March.

p: HBO Max is expanding its international television catalog with an upcoming German crime thriller limited series titled Sonnental. A brand new teaser trailer has officially made its way online, offering audiences a first look at the dark and suspenseful atmosphere of the show. Scheduled to premiere in March, the project has already generated significant buzz due to the creative minds driving its production.

The streaming platform is positioning the title as a major global release, utilizing a compelling teaser to showcase its eerie tone. Fans of international television mysteries will soon have a fresh narrative to dive into when the entire limited series lands on the service.

body.h: The Creative Minds Behind the Project
p: One of the primary reasons for the growing anticipation surrounding the series is its pedigree. The project hails from the creative team behind Dark, the critically acclaimed German sci-fi series that captivated global audiences with its complex narrative and brooding atmosphere. Bringing that same distinct sensibility to a new genre, the creators are shifting their focus from time-travel puzzles to grounded, chilling mystery.

This lineage assures viewers that the upcoming show will maintain a high standard of visual and narrative craftsmanship. The pedigree of the production team heavily influences expectations, marking the project as one of the most anticipated international television events of the spring.

At the center of the narrative is a brutal and unsettling killing that sets the main investigation into motion. Intriguingly, the grim murder is directly inspired by a children's book that was originally designed to thwart misbehaving kids. This bizarre and disturbing connection forms the backbone of the mystery, intertwining innocent childhood elements with dark criminal intent.

As the narrative unfolds across the limited run, the investigation digs deeper into the unsettling folklore of the children's book. This unique thematic anchor separates the project from standard procedural dramas, introducing psychological layers to the storytelling.

The series features a talented principal cast filled with notable names from European television. Among the leading actors are co-stars Lisa Vicari, who is widely recognized for her standout work in Dark, and Peter Kurth, known for his compelling performance in Babylon Berlin.

Vicari and Kurth star as two German investigators tasked with untangling the web of secrets surrounding the homicide. Their dynamic and the gritty investigation they spearhead serve as the primary emotional and dramatic anchor for the limited series.

For fans of binge-watching, HBO Max has structured the rollout to satisfy immediate viewing habits. The streaming platform is set to drop all six episodes of the German limited series simultaneously upon its release in March.

This all-at-once release format allows audiences to immerse themselves completely in the unfolding mystery without waiting week-to-week. It reflects a growing trend for high-profile limited series designed for deep, uninterrupted engagement.

HBO Max is set to release the six-episode German crime thriller limited series Sonnental in March, complete with a newly debuted teaser trailer. Created by the minds behind Dark, the show features actors Lisa Vicari and Peter Kurth as two investigators unraveling a brutal murder inspired by a children's book.

articles.headline: Sai Pallavi Debuts Short Hair And Pregnant Look In Mani Ratnam's Inji Vellam First Single Aachi Aachi
articles.dek: The inaugural track from Mani Ratnam's upcoming film Inji Vellam features Sai Pallavi in a striking transformation, with music composed by A.R. Rahman.

p: The makers of the upcoming cinematic venture Inji Vellam have released the very first musical track from the project, titled Aachi Aachi.
The song immediately drew attention for showcasing lead actor Sai Pallavi in a radically different visual style than what audiences have witnessed previously.
In the newly released video, Sai Pallavi appears portraying a pregnant character sporting a short, boyish hairstyle.
Alongside her dramatic physical makeover, she executes energetic choreography that has quickly become a primary talking point among viewers online.
Audiences and fans have taken to social media platforms like X to express their astonishment and appreciation for the unexpected makeover.
Listeners have highlighted her effortless carriage of the short-hair era, with some voicing hopes for a classic romance theme under the direction of Mani Ratnam.
The track features composition by A.R. Rahman, blending together a mix of Tamil and Malayalam lyrics written by Ilango Krishnan.
Vocal duties for the single are handled by Vaishali Samant and Sharanya Srinivas, bringing the veteran composer's signature magic back to the forefront.
Inji Vellam pairs Sai Pallavi alongside Vijay Sethupathi, marking the first time the two prominent actors are collaborating on screen.
Principal photography has heavily involved locations such as Kolkata, while the broader narrative and character specifics remain tightly under wraps.
The film reunites veteran filmmaker Mani Ratnam with composer A.R. Rahman for yet another cinematic partnership.
Technical credits include cinematography overseen by Avik Mukhopadhayay and editing managed by Sreekar Prasad, under production banners Madras Talkies and Lyca Productions.
Produced by Subaskaran, Mani Ratnam, and Siva Ananth, the movie is gearing up for a widespread theatrical rollout.
The official global release date for Inji Vellam in theaters is locked in for January 29, 2027.

The first track Aachi Aachi from Mani Ratnam's film Inji Vellam has debuted online, highlighting a short-haired pregnant look for actor Sai Pallavi. Composed by A.R. Rahman with lyrics by Ilango Krishnan, the song pairs Sai Pallavi with Vijay Sethupathi ahead of the film's global theatrical release on January 29, 2027.

articles.headline: LEGO Launches Massive 5,363-Piece Godzilla Set for Black Friday
articles.dek: Fans of the iconic movie monster can now spend their holidays building a giant, highly detailed replica complete with atomic breath and customisable poses.

body.h: A Plastic Kaiju for the Holidays
p: For decades, the cinematic legacy of Godzilla has been defined by the creature's destructive power over metropolitan landscapes. Transforming that massive scale into an intricate building experience offers a fun contrast for fans of the monster movies.
LEGO has introduced a sprawling new kit timed perfectly for holiday shopping, giving enthusiasts a complex project to tackle as the year draws to a close.
The newly launched collector model officially became available starting November 27. It carries a retail price of $449.99 and is sold exclusively through official LEGO retail channels.
Prospective builders will need to set aside plenty of time for assembly, as the product is specifically designed for mature fans aged 18 and older.

Drawing direct inspiration from the design seen in recent MonsterVerse features, the finished model towers at over 27.5 inches tall. Designers incorporated thousands of individual pieces to capture the intricate texture of the kaiju's skin.
Despite the uniform coloration of the creature, subtle variations like the vibrant blue dorsal plates running down the spine and tail add striking visual contrast to the finished build.
The completed figure features extensive articulation, allowing builders to adjust individual fingers, the tail, and overall stances to create dynamic display setups.
A standout feature of the kit is the atomic breath attachment protruding from the mouth. Those who prefer a more traditional look can easily swap this piece out for a standard red tongue.

body.h: Exclusive Black Friday Gift With Purchase
p: Aligning with major holiday shopping events, early buyers can secure a special promotional companion item alongside their main purchase while supplies last.
This secondary offering consists of a 359-piece Godzilla Logo Footprint set, which is scheduled to run as a promotional gift from November 27 through November 30.
The smaller footprint companion set was intentionally crafted to sit right alongside the towering primary build for a complete thematic presentation.
Because this promotional item is exclusively tied to the holiday promotional window and cannot be bought separately, it is expected to become a sought-after collectible.

LEGO has released a massive 5,363-piece Godzilla building set for Black Friday, priced at $449.99. Buyers purchasing the model between November 27 and November 30 also receive a complimentary 359-piece Godzilla Logo Footprint set.
